title: Objects inside an array inside an object, default config
rationale: The commonest real payload shape. It fails in a way that is worse than lossy: it produces a well-formed document of the wrong shape with duplicated content, which nothing downstream can detect.
catchesBugClass: Prefix over-attribution in analyzeStructure and the missing nested-holder case in reconstructArray. Also catches silent record inflation: a 1-object document reconstructs as a multi-element array, so any downstream count is wrong.
cannotCatch: It cannot separate the two defects - over-attribution of the outer prefix and reconstructArray failing to recurse into holders - since either alone still produces a wrong document. Asserting the exact expected output rather than merely "not equal" is what makes a partial fix visible.

predicted.detail: Flatten is correct. analyzeStructure attributes the whole key value to every prefix, so both order and order_items are flagged as array paths, and the enclosing object becomes an array of identical elements while the real array becomes an object of raw text.
